template.entry_long: close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high, {p0}) and roc(close, {p1}) > {p0}
template.notes: A strong bullish counter-trend candle closing above the 14-bar-ago swing high with positive ROC(5) is the documented wide breakout; EMA(10) loss is the reversal exit. The five-minute timeframe, pip stop/target/trailing and the signal-reversal and flatten toggles are not representable, and no numeric protection values are documented.
